effect.black-white: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
effect.black-2-white-2: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

short_effect.black-white: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
short_effect.black-2-white-2: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.

flavor_text.black-white: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.
flavor_text.black-2-white-2: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.
